name: Break circular dependency causing runtime undefined class inheritance
description: Resolve circular dependency between User and Account by extracting common base types into src/base.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: src/user.ts and src/account.ts have a circular dependency where Account extends BaseEntity from user.ts, and user.ts imports Account. This causes a runtime error: 'Super expression must either be null or a function, not undefined'. Extract the common base class BaseEntity into a new file src/base.ts and update imports to eliminate the circular dependency.

acceptance_criteria: src/user.ts and src/account.ts import BaseEntity from ./base
